cover.title: Two desks, one product story
cover.overview: Write a one-page comparison: how the DITA book and the AEM family tell the same Kitepump story, and where they must differ.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

blocks.body: Write a one-page comparison: how the DITA book and the AEM family tell the same Kitepump story, and where they must differ.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: One story
blocks.body:
Kitepump on the beach. The book explains how. The site sells the beach card. They share a name, not a file format.

Write four rows:

1. **Product name** :  key vs page title
2. **Procedure** :  task vs a short page that points at help
3. **Warning** :  reused DITA vs a short Text line
4. **Publish** :  transform or baseline vs Quick Publish

The two publish buttons are not the same button. If the sheet says they are, rewrite the row.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: The sheet claims the two publishes are the same button.

Expected: Four rows saved.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Row: product name :  key in DITA vs title on the page.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Row: procedure :  task vs a short page that points at help (not a fake how-to in Text).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Row: warning :  reused DITA warning vs a short Text warning (not a reused DITA id).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Row: publish :  transform or baseline vs Quick Publish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Do not claim the two publish buttons are the same button.

blocks.q: One product story means one CMS. True or not?
options: True :  pick Oxygen or AEM and delete the other
Not true :  one product story, two desks of tools
blocks.why: That is the point of the capstone. Same pump. Two desks.

blocks.q: Which row is a key in the map on one desk, and a page title on the other?
blocks.why: The name is a key in DITA and a title on the page. Same story, different pointer.
